-health-check.name: -health-check
-health-check.description: Internal health check tool. Verifies OAuth credentials and connectivity to Canva.

get-user.name: get-user
get-user.description: Get the authenticated Canva user. Returns curated { userId, teamId }. Params: fields?, includeRaw.

params.includeRaw: Return raw Canva /users/me response. Default false.

get-user-profile.name: get-user-profile
get-user-profile.description: Get the authenticated user's profile. Returns curated { displayName }. Params: fields?, includeRaw.

params.includeRaw: Return raw Canva profile response. Default false.

get-user-capabilities.name: get-user-capabilities
get-user-capabilities.description: Get the authenticated user capabilities (Canva plan + role gating). Returns curated { capabilities: string[] }. Use to decide whether features like brand templates or autofill are available before calling them. Params: fields?, includeRaw.

params.includeRaw: Return raw Canva capabilities response. Default false.

list-designs.name: list-designs
list-designs.description: List designs in the user's account with search/sort/pagination. Returns curated rows with thumbnail URL for inline preview. Params: query?, ownership? (any|owned|shared), sortBy?, limit (1-100, def 25), continuation?, fields?, includeRaw.

params.includeRaw: Return raw Canva response. Default false.

get-design.name: get-design
get-design.description: Get a Canva design by ID. Returns curated detail (id, title, ownerUserId/teamId, thumbnail*, edit/view URLs, pageCount, dates). Params: designId, fields?, includeRaw.

params.includeRaw: Return raw Canva design response. Default false.

create-design.name: create-design
create-design.description: Create a new Canva design. Use designType=custom with width+height for a custom canvas, or one of the preset names (doc, whiteboard, presentation, email). Returns curated design. Not retryable. Params: designType, title?, width?, height?, assetId?, fields?, includeRaw.

params.title: Optional name for the new design.
params.assetId: Optional asset ID to insert into the new design.
params.includeRaw: Return raw Canva response. Default false.

get-design-pages.name: get-design-pages
get-design-pages.description: Get pages of a Canva design with thumbnails (returns dimensions for bounded designs). Returns curated { pages: [{ index, thumbnailUrl, width, height }] }. Params: designId, fields?, includeRaw.

params.includeRaw: Return raw Canva pages response. Default false.

get-design-export-formats.name: get-design-export-formats
get-design-export-formats.description: List the export formats supported by a specific design. Use this before export-design to avoid 400 errors on unsupported formats. Returns curated { formats: string[] }. Params: designId, fields?, includeRaw.

params.includeRaw: Return raw Canva formats response. Default false.

export-design.name: export-design
export-design.description: Start an export job for a design. Returns curated job (poll get-export-job by id). Formats: pdf, png, jpg, gif, pptx, mp4, html_bundle, html_standalone. transparentBackground only for png. Not retryable. Params: designId, format, quality?, width?, height?, pages?, transparentBackground?, fields?, includeRaw.

params.transparentBackground: PNG only — keep canvas transparent. Default false.
params.includeRaw: Return raw Canva job response. Default false.

get-export-job.name: get-export-job
get-export-job.description: Get an export job status/result. Returns curated job { id, status, error, result.urls? }. Params: exportId, fields?, includeRaw.

params.exportId: Export job ID returned by export-design.
params.includeRaw: Return raw Canva job response. Default false.

create-resize-job.name: create-resize-job
create-resize-job.description: Resize a design to a new size (preset or custom). Async — returns curated job (poll get-resize-job). Use designType="custom" with width+height OR a preset name. Output is a NEW design at top level. Not retryable. Params: designId, designType, width?, height?, fields?, includeRaw.

params.includeRaw: Return raw Canva job response. Default false.

get-resize-job.name: get-resize-job
get-resize-job.description: Get a resize job status/result. Returns curated job { id, status, error, result: design? }. Params: jobId, fields?, includeRaw.

params.includeRaw: Return raw Canva job response. Default false.

import-design.name: import-design
import-design.description: Import an external file (e.g. PDF, PPTX, DOCX) as a new Canva design. Async — returns curated job (poll get-import-job by id). url must be http/https. Not retryable. Params: title, url, mimeType?, fields?, includeRaw.

params.title: Title for the imported design.
params.url: Publicly accessible http/https URL of the source file.
params.includeRaw: Return raw Canva job response. Default false.

get-import-job.name: get-import-job
get-import-job.description: Get a URL design import job status/result. Returns curated job { id, status, error, result.designId? }. Params: jobId, fields?, includeRaw.

params.includeRaw: Return raw Canva job response. Default false.

list-folders.name: list-folders
list-folders.description: List items in a folder (designs, sub-folders, images, videos). Use folderId="root" for top level. Returns curated rows with thumbnail URL. Params: folderId, itemTypes?, sortBy?, pinStatus? (pinned|unpinned), limit (1-100, def 50), continuation?, fields?, includeRaw.

params.includeRaw: Return raw Canva response. Default false.

get-folder.name: get-folder
get-folder.description: Get folder metadata. Returns curated { id, name, thumbnailUrl, dates }. Params: folderId, fields?, includeRaw.

params.includeRaw: Return raw Canva folder response. Default false.

create-folder.name: create-folder
create-folder.description: Create a new folder under a parent. Use parentFolderId="root" for top level. Returns curated folder. Not retryable. Params: name, parentFolderId, fields?, includeRaw.

params.name: Folder name.
params.parentFolderId: Parent folder ID ("root" for top level).
params.includeRaw: Return raw Canva folder response. Default false.

update-folder.name: update-folder
update-folder.description: Rename a folder. Idempotent. Returns curated folder. Params: folderId, name, fields?, includeRaw.

params.name: New folder name.
params.includeRaw: Return raw Canva folder response. Default false.

delete-folder.name: delete-folder
delete-folder.description: Delete a folder. Items in the folder are moved to the parent. Idempotent — repeated deletes return 404. Returns { folderId, deleted: true }. Params: folderId.

move-item.name: move-item
move-item.description: Move an item (design / folder / asset) to another folder. Idempotent if target unchanged. Returns { itemId, toFolderId, moved: true }. Params: itemId, toFolderId.

params.itemId: ID of the item to move.
params.toFolderId: Destination folder ID (use "root" for top level).

upload-asset.name: upload-asset
upload-asset.description: Upload an asset (image, video, audio) to the user library from a public URL. Async — returns curated job (poll get-asset-upload-job by id). url must be http/https. Not retryable. Params: name, url, fields?, includeRaw.

params.name: Display name for the new asset.
params.url: Publicly accessible http/https URL of the file.
params.includeRaw: Return raw Canva job response. Default false.

get-asset-upload-job.name: get-asset-upload-job
get-asset-upload-job.description: Get an asset URL upload job status/result. Returns curated job { id, status, error, result: {asset shape with thumbnailUrl}? }. Params: jobId, fields?, includeRaw.

params.includeRaw: Return raw Canva job response. Default false.

get-asset.name: get-asset
get-asset.description: Get asset metadata. Returns curated { id, name, type, thumbnail*, tags, metadata, dates }. Params: assetId, fields?, includeRaw.

params.includeRaw: Return raw Canva asset response. Default false.

update-asset.name: update-asset
update-asset.description: Update asset metadata (rename, retag). Idempotent — same payload yields same final state. Returns curated asset. Params: assetId, name?, tags?, fields?, includeRaw.

params.name: New display name.
params.includeRaw: Return raw Canva asset response. Default false.

delete-asset.name: delete-asset
delete-asset.description: Delete an asset (moved to trash). Idempotent — repeated deletes return 404 (already deleted). Returns { assetId, deleted: true }. Params: assetId.

list-brand-templates.name: list-brand-templates
list-brand-templates.description: List brand templates the user can access (requires Canva Enterprise). Returns curated rows with thumbnail URL. Params: query?, ownership?, limit (1-100, def 25), continuation?, fields?, includeRaw.

params.includeRaw: Return raw Canva response. Default false.

get-brand-template.name: get-brand-template
get-brand-template.description: Get brand template metadata. Returns curated detail (id, title, thumbnailUrl, viewUrl, createUrl, dates). Params: brandTemplateId, fields?, includeRaw.

params.includeRaw: Return raw Canva response. Default false.

get-brand-template-dataset.name: get-brand-template-dataset
get-brand-template-dataset.description: Get the autofill dataset (named fields like {title}, {body}, {image}) for a brand template. Returned shape mirrors Canva — useful before calling autofill-design. Params: brandTemplateId.

autofill-design.name: autofill-design
autofill-design.description: Create a design by autofilling a brand template with named fields. data keys must match the template dataset (call get-brand-template-dataset first). columnConfigs: optional chart-data field definitions. Async — returns curated job (poll get-autofill-job). Not retryable. Params: brandTemplateId, data, title?, columnConfigs?, fields?, includeRaw.

params.title: Title for the new design.
params.data: Field name → value object matching the template dataset.
params.columnConfigs: Optional column configurations for chart fields (added 2026-03). Map field name → { type, ... }.
params.includeRaw: Return raw Canva job response. Default false.

get-autofill-job.name: get-autofill-job
get-autofill-job.description: Get an autofill job status/result. Returns curated job { id, status, error, result: design? }. Params: jobId, fields?, includeRaw.

params.includeRaw: Return raw Canva job response. Default false.

create-thread.name: create-thread
create-thread.description: Create a comment thread on a design. message ≤ 2048 chars. Returns curated thread. Not retryable. Params: designId, message, fields?, includeRaw.

params.includeRaw: Return raw Canva thread response. Default false.

get-thread.name: get-thread
get-thread.description: Get a comment thread by ID. Returns curated thread. Params: designId, threadId, fields?, includeRaw.

params.designId: Canva design ID the thread belongs to.
params.includeRaw: Return raw Canva thread response. Default false.

list-replies.name: list-replies
list-replies.description: List replies to a comment thread. Returns curated rows. Params: designId, threadId, limit (1-100, def 50), continuation?, fields?, includeRaw.

params.designId: Canva design ID the thread belongs to.
params.includeRaw: Return raw Canva response. Default false.

create-reply.name: create-reply
create-reply.description: Reply to a comment thread. message ≤ 2048 chars. Returns curated reply. Not retryable. Params: designId, threadId, message, fields?, includeRaw.

params.designId: Canva design ID the thread belongs to.
params.includeRaw: Return raw Canva reply response. Default false.

get-reply.name: get-reply
get-reply.description: Get a single reply within a comment thread. Returns curated reply. Params: designId, threadId, replyId, fields?, includeRaw.

params.includeRaw: Return raw Canva reply response. Default false.

name: Canva
description: Canva design management — designs, exports, resizes, folders, assets, brand templates, autofill, and comments via the Canva Connect API.

changelog.notes: Create, export, resize and import designs, organize folders and assets, autofill brand templates, and manage comments
